questions.answer: A concise restatement of communicated substance.

questions.prompt: What makes a meaning reflection tentative?
questions.answer: It presents an interpretation open to correction.

questions.prompt: How should a listener respond to correction?
questions.answer: Acknowledge it and revise the understanding.
questions.feedback: Do not defend a mistaken guess.

questions.prompt: Does this lesson qualify a learner to deliver clinical MI?
questions.answer: No; it teaches ordinary communication literacy.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Produces accurate reflections, responds to correction, offers relevant assistance and maintains non-clinical role boundaries.
scoring.transfer: Write a fictional four-turn listening exchange with a speaker correction, revised reflection and question about whether assistance is wanted. Provide an equivalent written format and evaluate accuracy, consent and relevance.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
